seoTitle: Pagination Link and Canonical Checker for Paged Series
metaDescription: Review a paginated series from pasted HTML: canonicals, prev/next, fragment links and noindex. Explains how Google treats pagination.
intro: Checks the head of each page in a paginated series for common mistakes.
why:
A common mistake is a canonical on every paged URL that points to page one. Google advises against that and wants each page to have its own canonical.

Google no longer uses rel=prev/next as an indexing signal, though other engines may. The tool checks canonicals, prev/next reciprocity, fragment links and noindex across the pages you paste. Page numbers are guessed from common URL patterns.
howTo: Paste each page after a URL: line, separated by ---.
Include at least two pages for reciprocity checks.
Fix errors, then review the warnings.

faq.a: No longer, per its documentation. Other engines may.
Each page has different content, so each needs its own canonical.
